source_contract: Pinned server go.mod replaces github.com/pion/webrtc/v4 with github.com/livekit/webrtc-pion/v4 v4.2.18-warp.6.

Pion rtpsender.go152-197: AddEncoding requires nonempty distinct RIDs, identical track ID/stream/kind and must precede Send. 301-374: Send binds exact per-encoding SSRCs. track_local_static.go184-214: WriteRTP substitutes bound SSRC/PT but does not populate MID/RID. Observer explicitly sets both negotiated extensions.

Pion sdp.go453-528 emits both SSRCs plus q/f send RID and simulcast send q;f without rewriting SDP. 240-252 replaces parsed SSRC track-details with RID-only details when RID/msid present. peerconnection.go1683-1707 refuses legacy undeclared fallback when RID present.

Pion peerconnection.go1831-1908 peeks first SRTP packet and parses MID/RID; 1912-1976 only probes additional packets if IDs missing, otherwise calls receiveForRid then onTrack. rtpreceiver.go552-592 sets codec/SSRC/streams without needing a frame or another packet. Runtime callback and stats still unverified.

Server participant.go1113-1169 updates codec spatial/RID from SDP; 3125-3137 sorts layers without deduplication; 3275-3278 sets multi-layer simulcast. 3525-3539 updates MIME/top layers, 3571 adds receiver before 3605 publication; 3787-3798 invokes public listener before telemetry.

buffer/videolayerutils.go281-345 maps LOW/HIGH to spatial0/1 including duplicate LOW; 210-211 maps quality to RID via spatial; 498-519 preserves sparse q/f order. mediatrackreceiver.go675-729 assigns SSRC only to first matching quality and propagates codec layers to top level. No unknown or negative quality rows.
evidence: Exclusive JSONL and synchronous fsynced eventjournal retain full SID/version-bearing callback/settled TrackInfo, callback write attempts, actual ACK, offer/answer, negotiated extension IDs, exact plaintext RTP handed to bound Pion SRTP writer, write result, quiet/settled/final counts, receiver stats, closure checks and deadline diagnostics. RTP hex is not claimed to be a wire ciphertext capture. Deterministic projection excludes only SID/version; failed cases may lack completed observation rows and remain failures.
network: Both endpoints disable mDNS, use UDP4 only with explicit loopback candidate inclusion/filter and retained 127.0.0.1:0 UDP mux sockets; reject ports7880/7881 and non-loopback candidates. No STUN/TURN or HTTP server. Close participant, peer, muxes; verify peer closed callback and closed UDP writes.
